content: Can you help me plan a trip to Japan? I want to visit Tokyo and Kyoto. I love tea culture there.
Japan is wonderful for tea enthusiasts! In Kyoto, you should visit Uji, famous for its matcha.
I've been to Japan once before, in 2019. Loved it. Want to take my family this time — Avni would love the cherry blossoms.
Cherry blossom season is magical, especially with children. Late March to early April is ideal.
Budget isn't a huge concern, but I'm practical. I'd rather spend on experiences than luxury hotels. Maybe some nice ryokans though.
